description: Simple arithmetic should compile.
Assigning string to int should fail.
Passing string into int parameter should fail.
Returning string from int function should fail.
Unknown global call should report unknown symbol.
Unknown identifier usage should fail.
Unclosed block should produce parser delimiter diagnostics.
Unterminated string literal should be rejected.
Reserved keyword local declaration should fail.
Required parameter after optional should fail.
Unknown local declaration type should fail.
Unknown return type should fail.
Typed helper calls should compile.
Namespace call should compile.
Nested array index assignment should compile.
Unresolved auto value passed to print should fail overload resolution.
cast expression should compile.
Calling with wrong arity should fail.
Const in reference parameter usage should compile.
Shadowing should compile but emit a warning.
